correctness.rationale: The self-contained checker reconstructs 40 generators and 637 distinct cells, verifies every signed boundary-square, all 311 distinct ±1 incidence pairs, full acyclicity via topological sort and all 48 zero integral critical degree-4-to-degree-3 boundary entries. The resulting CW model contains one 0-cell, six 3-cells and eight 4-cells; its 4-cell attaching maps vanish by π3≅H3 for a 2-connected wedge of 3-spheres, proving the exact homotopy statement.

value.rationale: The complete three-cycle conjugacy class in the symmetric group is a canonical, algebraically motivated generator set. Its six-letter permutation complex displays integral mixed-dimensional topology despite purity, giving a non-shellability obstruction and a reproducible homotopy classification with 311 unit Morse cancellations. This goes beyond an Euler-characteristic or field-Betti exercise. No unproved infinite-family generalization is claimed.
